newProjectWizard.description_description_projectProjectDi: In the project’s “Project dictionary”, click “Generate GPT dictionary with AI”: GenDic reads the source text, extracts personal names, place names and proper nouns, and fixes their translations (the results are merged into 项目GPT字典-生成.txt).
newProjectWizard.description_description_dictionarySave: Check the translations and remove the ordinary words that should not be collected. The dictionary is split by category and can be edited directly in its cards; remember to save when you are done.
newProjectWizard.description_description_startTranslation: Go back to “Start translation”, pick a template and start. Before the full run, try translating one or two files to confirm the style and the terminology.
newProjectWizard.title_title_translationProblem: Review the results and the problems
newProjectWizard.description_description_textTranslationT: Review the translations and the detected problem sentences (leftover Japanese, missing control codes, longer than the Japanese, and so on) in “Browse text”, then extend the dictionary or fix the translations accordingly.
newProjectWizard.description_description_dictionaryRebuil: After editing the dictionary, click “Build output” (rebuilda) to refresh the cache and the results with it; the final translations are collected from the gt_output folder.
